# `sha2`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a checksum of SHA-2 family as a hex string of `expr`.
SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 are supported. Bit length of 0 is equivalent to 256.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
sha2(expr, bitLength)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `hash_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- sha2, example 1
> SELECT sha2('Spark', 256);
529bc3b07127ecb7e53a4dcf1991d9152c24537d919178022b2c42657f79a26b
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
